adapter_candidate.weight_scope: supplier product-page weight field, not measured assembly mass
adapter_candidate.host_interface: USB serial with manufacturer framing; do not assume native SocketCAN
remaining_gates: protocol mode and ARM64 sustained latency/loss verification
USB power draw and ground/noise verification

ttl_branch.data: DYNAMIXEL half-duplex TTL, separate interface and power branch; not CAN

budget.host_framing_mode_status: 20-byte mode supported by supplier; actual command/response protocol mode not commissioned

wiring_rules: Each CAN bus is a line with exactly two 120ohm terminations at its physical ends; enable adapter termination only when it is at one end.
Use twisted H/L signal pairs with a defined motor-side signal reference; adapter A has no established isolation claim. USB/hub ground does not substitute for a reviewed motor power-return path.
Power distribution branches independently from the protected motor rail; the CAN signal chain is not a high-current power daisy chain.
Motor connector pin numbering/polarity must use the correct A2 mating-cable drawing and continuity test; connector name alone does not establish pin order.
Commission motors one at a time; record physical bus plus node ID and serialized device identity. Do not identify by ttyUSB enumeration alone.
Loss or fault of either motor bus triggers coordinated stopping of the whole robot; emergency-stop hardware cannot depend on USB or the application loop.
unresolved_power_dependency: AK48 supply/regeneration window and actual motor power disconnect/clamp hardware remain unconfirmed; this file does not approve battery operation.
